questions.q: What helps a new starter most in week one?
options: Being left to figure it all out
Working access, a buddy, and clear first goals
questions.explain: Tools that work, a friendly guide, and clarity on goals beat any document dump.

options: A friendly peer who answers the small questions
questions.explain: A peer buddy makes it safe to ask the 'silly' questions everyone actually has.

questions.q: When should first objectives be set?
options: Early — so the new starter knows what good looks like
questions.explain: Early, clear 30/60/90-day goals turn enthusiasm into focused progress.

options: Both ways — the new starter sees gaps you've gone blind to
questions.explain: Fresh eyes spot broken steps. Ask new starters what was confusing.

options: Watching how the team actually behaves day to day
questions.explain: People absorb culture from lived behaviour, not posters. Model it deliberately.

options: The new starter is contributing and knows where to get help
questions.explain: Confident contribution plus knowing where to turn = a successful start.
